## Checklist

- [ ] Change is focused and follows existing project patterns.
- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior or regression, or testing is not applicable.
- [ ] `./test.sh --quick` passed during iteration.
- [ ] `./test.sh` passes, or Validation explains narrower proportional checks.
- [ ] Relevant CLI, daemon, MCP, browser, neural, or artifact E2E passes, or E2E is not applicable.
- [ ] User-facing docs and changelog are updated when needed.
- [ ] Performance and relevance claims include reproducible evidence.
- [ ] No private code, credentials, generated caches, or local paths are committed.
